# Beiqiang Footwear

> Quanzhou footwear factory supplier for overseas B2B buyers. The website supports wholesale, private-label and OEM/ODM sourcing discussions; it is not a retail checkout.

## Important commercial boundaries

- The website currently contains 31 organized product pages; this is not the factory's entire product range.
- Product pages show reviewed product images and available product-package facts.
- Wide-toe claims are limited to BQ001, BQ002 and BQ031. Other styles are not presented as wide-toe products.
- Price, MOQ, materials, color and size availability, packing, samples, lead time, testing and trade terms require project-specific written confirmation.
- Formal transactions proceed through Alibaba Trade Assurance or a signed bilateral contract.
